1. (Currently amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) for enabling a user to apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data includes __specific spatial coordinates and dimensional measurements of the graphical elements relative to anatomical structures in the medical image__;
- a reporting subsystem (180) for:
i) accessing a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414),
ii) retrieving a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, __wherein the association data comprises rules that map specific combinations of graphical element types, positions, and marked anatomical structures to corresponding medical information items__, and
iii) generating a report (182) based on the medical information item, __wherein the report includes automated clinical decision support information derived from the marked anatomical structures and measurement data__.

2. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information in generating the report (182), __and wherein the codified version is generated through a macro that analyzes the specific spatial relationships between the graphical elements and anatomical structures__.

3. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user, __wherein each selectable graphical element is associated with a specific anatomical structure or measurement parameter__, and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element, __wherein the report generation includes automated retrieval of clinical guidelines or reference values corresponding to the selected anatomical structure__.

4. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414), __wherein the macro analyzes the spatial coordinates and measurement data of the graphical elements to determine clinical significance__.

5. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro.

6. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks, and wherein the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414), __wherein the hyperlinks are dynamically generated based on the anatomical structures marked by the graphical elements__.

7. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412), and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay, __wherein the overlay displays measurement values and anatomical identifiers corresponding to the marked structures__.

8. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement, __wherein the measurement data includes quantitative values of anatomical dimensions that are compared against reference standards to generate clinical assessments__.

9. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) in generating the report (182), __wherein the report includes automated comparison of the measured values to normal reference ranges and flagging of abnormal findings__.

10. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066), __wherein the rules are based on anatomical location, measurement parameters, and clinical context__.

11. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Previously presented) Workstation or imaging apparatus comprising the system according to claim 1.

14. (Currently amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, __wherein the application data includes specific spatial coordinates and dimensional measurements of the graphical elements relative to anatomical structures__;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, __wherein the association data comprises rules that map specific combinations of graphical element types, positions, and marked anatomical structures to corresponding medical information items__; and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item, __wherein the report includes automated clinical decision support information derived from the marked anatomical structures and measurement data__.

15. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
